about: The Tasks tree (Outline): which rows show and how (group rows under All groups, leaf counts, the Show choices, search, zoom and its path, Open to, titles without the parent's name). Only how the tree is shown; nothing in the tasks changes. Generated by the C# core (OutlineFixtureTests, Outline.cs); the web app (tests/web/outline.test.mjs, outlinemodel.js), Swift and Kotlin run it.

shape.now: the time every case is worked out at (states depend on it: snoozed tasks wait until the day after)
shape.groups: the board's groups, in order (a new board's Work and Personal, then Errands, added; Errands has no tasks)
shape.tasks: { key, title, group?: name (top-level tasks), parent?: key, sequential?: true, done?: true, archived?: true, snoozed?: true }, added in this order at `now`; then, in order, done ones are completed (a parent's subtasks with it), snoozed ones deferred until `snoozedUntil`, archived ones archived
shape.nodes: what /api/tree says about each task at `now` (state, doneCount, totalCount): for a port that reads the tree from the server (the web app) instead of working it out
shape.titles: { title, parent, parentShown, shown }: shownTitle(title, parentTitle, parentShownTitle). When the title starts with the parent's title (any case) followed by ':', ' -', ' –' or ' —', the rest with leading spaces dropped, unless that's empty; when that leaves it as it was and the parent is shown shorter (parentShown, null: not), the same against that. In rows, a task's parentShown is its parent's row title (at the top of a zoom: the zoomed task's title in the path)
shape.tags: { tags, parent, shown }: shownTags(tags, parentTags). A row shows only the tags its parent task doesn't also have (compared as titles are: any case, no normalization), in the task's order; a top-level task (parent null) shows all of them. In rows, a task's parent is its parent task (at the top of a zoom: the zoomed task); only how the row is drawn, the task keeps every tag
shape.cases[].options: { group: name|null (null: all groups), zoom: key|null (a key that isn't a task: a task that's gone), show: todo|now|waiting|all, query: search text|null, expanded: [keys] (open tasks), closedGroups: [names] }
shape.cases[].keep: with a query: the tasks the search keeps (matches, their parents and their subtasks; what /api/tree?q= returns), in the order of `tasks`
shape.cases[].zoom: resolveZoom: the zoom drawn (key) or null (the top): the remembered one, or while a search leaves it out its nearest parent the search keeps (for now). The Show choice never moves it (it only narrows what's under it)
shape.cases[].remembered: rememberedZoom: the zoom a device keeps (key) or null. The asked task unless it's really gone: deleted, archived or in another group than the one picked: null; without subtasks: its parent. A search or a Show choice doesn't change it
shape.cases[].zoomUp: zoomUp: where Back or Escape goes from the zoom drawn: its parent (the task part of the path before it), or null (out to the tree; also when not zoomed)
shape.cases[].rows: rows(board, options, now), in order: { kind: group|task, id: key or group name, depth, title (as shown), fullTitle, hasChildren (rows under it are shown when open), expanded, done, total (leaves under it; 0 for a task without subtasks; a group adds up its top-level tasks, a task without subtasks counting as one), left (total - done), state (actionable|waiting|locked|container|done; null for groups), outdent (it can move out one level: not top level, not at the top of a zoom) }
shape.cases[].path: path(board, options): [] unless zoomed; else { kind: all|group|task, id, title, done, total }: All groups, the group, each parent, the zoomed task (a task part's title as shown under the part before it)
shape.cases[].newTask: where New task adds: { parent: the zoom (key) or null, group: the zoom's group, else the group picked, else the first group }
shape.cases[].openTo: openTo(board, options, level) for each level (groups, tasks, subtasks, all): the sets afterwards (order doesn't matter; listed in the order of tasks and groups) and the rows they give
shape.tree: the board before a move: each group's name, then its top-level tasks (archived ones too) and their subtasks, two spaces per level (keys)
shape.moves[].options: as cases[].options, without expanded and closedGroups (the moves don't depend on what's open)
shape.moves[].keep: with a query: what the search keeps, as cases[].keep
shape.moves[].move: { do: indent|outdent|up|down|drop|dropOnGroup|newTask, task, target?, zone?: before|inside|after, group? }. indent: under the sibling above it on screen, last; outdent: right after its parent (not at the top of a zoom: its row says outdent false); up/down: past the sibling above/below on screen. On screen: kept by the Show choice and the search; at the top level, only the task's own group's tasks. drop: before, inside (last) or after the target row (next to a task of another group: into that group); dropOnGroup: to the top of that group (nothing when it's already its first task); newTask: a task 'new' (title New) first at newTask's place
shape.moves[].tree: the board afterwards (as tree), or "refused" when the move can't be made or changes nothing

moves.name: Indent: under the task above on screen, last; a finished one To do hides is stepped over
Indent with Everything: under the finished task above
Indent with a search: only what the search keeps is next to it
Indent a group's first task under All groups: refused (another group's task isn't next to it)
Indent at the top level: under the task above in its own group
Outdent: out one level, right after its parent
Outdent to the top level: in its group, right after its parent
Outdent at the top of a zoom: refused (it would leave the view)
Outdent deeper in a zoom: right after its parent
Outdent a top-level task: refused
Up: past the task above on screen; a finished one To do hides is stepped over
Up from the top of its parent: refused
Down at the end of a group under All groups: refused (the next group's task isn't next to it)
Up with Can do now: only what can be done now is next to it
Down with a group picked: past the next task
Down with Everything: past the finished task below
Drop before a task of another group: into that group, before it
Drop after another task's subtask: under that task, after it
Drop before a sibling: only reordered
Drop inside a task: last under it
Drop a task into its own subtask: refused
Drop on a group's row: to the top of that group
Drop a subtask on its own group's row: to the top level, first
Drop a group's other task on its own group's row: to the top
Drop a group's first task on its own group's row: nothing to do
New task under All groups: first in the first group
New task with a search that hides the first group: first in the first group all the same
New task while zoomed: first inside the zoomed task
New task with a group picked: first in it
